style.prompt: Design a striking vertical flyer for a printmaking studio event. The ONLY text on the flyer must read exactly: "PRINTMAKERS' OPEN STUDIO". Make this headline large, beautifully composed, bold and highly legible, arranged in an intentional typographic hierarchy in the upper half. Authentic handmade linocut / woodblock print aesthetic, warm ivory textured paper, rich black and vermilion red two-ink palette, subtle ink misregistration, tactile carved marks. Illustrate a hand ink brayer, carved printing block and a small print with an abstract sun and botanical forms, in a clean dynamic composition around the headline. Independent art studio poster, sophisticated graphic design, generous negative space with a quiet blank ivory area near the bottom for future event details. Flat front-on artwork, full bleed, no mockup, no frame, no extra text, no invented date, address or contact information.
